summary: One-frame result of a mod.io dependency query (client only, registry total 32). ls::PublishingSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3BDE2A0; Toolkit GameEngine.dll ls::PublishingSystem::Process*Requests) creates it on a new entity from a request queued by the matching HandleUGC... callback of the mod.io back-end; the same frame also gets a UGCRequestResultOneFrameComponent with the net::UGCResult and request Guid. Request queue filled by HandleUGCItemDependencies(unsigned __int64, DynamicArray<net::UGCModDependency>, net::UGCResult, bool); drained by bg3.exe+0x3BDFC80 (request stride 0x58: id +0, UGCResult +8, array +0x30, bool +0x40, Guid +0x48).
